args.content:
Here is a suggested packing list for your Hawaii vacation:

Clothing:
- 3-4 tops or shirts
- 2-3 pairs of shorts or pants
- 1-2 lightweight dresses or jumpsuits
- 1-2 pairs of comfortable walking shoes
- 1-2 pairs of sandals or flip flops
- 1 light jacket or sweater (depending on the time of year)

Toiletries:
- Toothbrush and toothpaste
- Deodorant
- Shampoo and conditioner
- Soap
- Razor and shaving cream (if applicable)
- Makeup and makeup remover (if applicable)

Electronics:
- Smartphone and charger
- Laptop and charger (if necessary)
- Camera and charger (if you plan on taking a lot of photos)
- Portable charger
- Universal power adapter

Miscellaneous:
- Reef-safe sunscreen
- Insect repellent
- Beach towel
- Snorkeling gear (if applicable)
- Water bottle
- Collapsible cooler (if you plan on buying perishable items)

Additional tips:
- Pack lightweight, quick-drying clothing
- Bring a reusable water bottle
- Consider packing a small daypack for day trips
- Don't forget your sunscreen and insect repellent
- If you plan on hiking, bring comfortable hiking shoes
- If you plan on visiting any luaus, bring a lightweight, formal outfit

You can also consider packing:
- A small first aid kit
- A portable power strip
- A set of earplugs and eye mask (if you're a light sleeper)
- A small backpack for carrying essentials during the day

Remember to check with your airline for any luggage restrictions before your trip!
